educationalGoal: Students will acquire the ability to develop your own research plan, to solve the research issues in a limited time by collaborating with your research team, and to publish the results.
advice:
Research fields are as follows:

1. Development of methods to design artificial materials for high-performance nano-electromechanical systems (NEMS)
